en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammad Bin usman, from Zurara, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘He is free as he is withheld, whether he makes such stipulation or not’.
en.sarwar: 7. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Hammad ibn ‘Uthman from Zurarah who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
He is free as he is withheld, whether he makes such stipulation or not.’”
